stem: The transition elements are able to form stable complexes with a wide range of molecules and ions.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: The d orbitals in an isolated transition metal ion are degenerate. In complexes, the d orbitals occupy two energy levels.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text:
Complete the diagram to show the arrangement of d orbital energy levels in octahedral and in tetrahedral complexes.

{{figure:pdf_visual_01.png}}

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
Sketch the shape of **two** d orbitals:

- one d orbital from the lower energy level in an octahedral complex
- one d orbital from the higher energy level in an octahedral complex.

Use the axes below.

{{figure:pdf_visual_02.png}}

parts.label: (c)
(c)(i)
parts.text: On the diagram of $\text{edds}^{4-}$, circle each atom that forms a bond to the $\text{Fe}^{3+}$ ion in $[\text{Fe(edds)}]^{-}$.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text:
$[\text{Fe(edds)}]^{-}$ is red and $[\text{Fe(edta)}]^{-}$ is yellow.

Explain why the two complexes have different colours.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text:
When $\text{edds}^{4-}(\text{aq})$ is added to $\text{Fe}^{3+}(\text{aq})$, the following reaction occurs.

$$[\text{Fe}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{3+}(\text{aq}) + \text{edds}^{4-}(\text{aq}) \rightleftharpoons [\text{Fe(edds)}]^{-}(\text{aq}) + 6\text{H}_2\text{O}(\text{l})$$

State the type of reaction that occurs.

parts.label: (c)(iv)
parts.text: Write an expression for the stability constant, $K_{\text{stab}}$, of $[\text{Fe(edds)}]^{-}(\text{aq})$.

parts.label: (c)(v)
parts.text:
The table shows the values for the stability constants, $K_{\text{stab}}$, of both complexes.

| complex | $K_{\text{stab}} / \text{mol}^{-1}\text{dm}^{3}$ |
| :--- | :--- |
| $[\text{Fe(edds)}]^{-}$ | $3.98 \times 10^{20}$ |
| $[\text{Fe(edta)}]^{-}$ | $1.26 \times 10^{25}$ |

Predict which of the $[\text{Fe(edds)}]^{-}$ and $[\text{Fe(edta)}]^{-}$ complexes is more stable.

Explain your answer with reference to the $K_{\text{stab}}$ value for each complex.

parts.label: (c)(vi)
parts.text:
When an excess of $\text{edta}^{4-}(\text{aq})$ is added to $[\text{Fe(edds)}]^{-}(\text{aq})$, the following equilibrium is established.

$$[\text{Fe(edds)}]^{-}(\text{aq}) + \text{edta}^{4-}(\text{aq}) \rightleftharpoons [\text{Fe(edta)}]^{-}(\text{aq}) + \text{edds}^{4-}(\text{aq})$$

Calculate the equilibrium constant, $K_{\text{c}}$, for this equilibrium, using the $K_{\text{stab}}$ values given in the table in **(c)(v)**.
